correctness.rationale: The 13x13 Singer difference-set nonincidence matrix and self-dual parity-check matrix are explicit. All 8192 syndromes are exhaustively reached by BFS with maximum 5 and shortest paths divided by factorial to yield minimum-support counts. A disjoint independent direct enumeration of all error-coordinate subsets of sizes 0–5 gives identical syndrome-level distances and multiplicities. All 8192 codewords and full 5616-order collineation closure are exactly enumerated; an explicit duality doubles this to 11232, matching the full known automorphism-group order. Orbit closure partitions all 8192 states into 22 explicitly listed orbits, each homogeneous in distance and leader multiplicity; full standalone replay prints VERIFY_OK. Finite computations prove only this finite case and do not assert untested generalization.

value.rationale: The complete quotient-space nearest-codeword/leader statistics and 22 full automorphism orbits of a unique, classical [26,13,6] code are natural error-decoding and symmetry invariants. They distinguish 1990 deepest cosets into five group orbits with meaningful list-size classes 10,18,26, including a unique full-group-fixed deep coset. These data are neither routine restatements of the known codeword weight enumerator nor arbitrary parameter slices; they complete a natural finite geometrical classification, without alleging a novel code or general covering bound.
